narrative: Micron's June 22 equity-plus-multi-year-allocation deal with Anthropic leaves one lab coupled to all three HBM suppliers, and that asymmetry is precisely the competitive force the thesis names. It hands rivals a proven template and a sharp incentive to convert memory purchasing into a contested ownership stake before the expected Q4 2026 vendor listings.
remaining_gap: No non-Anthropic lab has yet been reported securing an equity-coupled HBM allocation, and Micron's investment size stays undisclosed.
